window-1.title: WigglyPaint
window-1.blurb: Every line you draw squirms and squeaks like it's alive, and you can export the whole wobbly mess as a GIF — it's the most charmingly imperfect drawing tool on the internet and I fully expect to see it in your next persona shoot's title cards.

window-2.title: Tedium: The Dull Side of the Internet
window-2.blurb: It goes absurdly deep on the unglamorous stuff — dead software, forgotten gadgets, weird old fonts — and every issue reads like a side quest someone left out for you to pick up.

window-3.title: Pandan Colada (Mocktail)
window-3.blurb: It's kaya toast and pandan chiffon cake reincarnated as a creamy green tiki drink — zero proof, absurdly photogenic, and exactly the kind of thing you'd make a whole persona shoot around.

window-4.title: The Selby — Inside Creative People's Homes
window-4.blurb: It's basically permission to let your rooms look like your brain — every shelf, taped photo and inherited lamp doing the decorating for you.

window-5.title: Labyrinth — Asia's 50 Best 2026, No. 40
window-5.blurb: It's your whole heritage-meets-remix obsession plated up — chai tao kuay and chilli crab reimagined by a chef who refuses to serve anything that didn't grow here, and exactly the kind of place worth inventing an occasion for.
